thread:
Priya: Heads-up — quick sync about pricing page experiments. Need to align calc variants, tier names, and FAQ microcopy before next week's webinar. 30m?
Marco: 30 works. I have a new calculator prototype (A: slider + instant est, B: dropdown presets). Want design feedback.
Jenna: I can do CTA + webinar blurb. Need exact band names and any commitment wording.
Evan: Sales asks for clearer 'committed vs metered' language. Also inbound routing rules: free trial leads -> SDR; committed trials -> AE. Can we lock triggers? :thinking_face: 
Alex: Quick data note — slider flow boosted trial starts ~8% in small sample but enterprise bounce went up on pricing page. Adding cohort breakdown in the doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/pricing-experiments (private)
Marco: Re: naming — option set: "Starter / Team / Scale" vs "Pay-as-you-go / Committed / Enterprise". UX prefers fewer words. Thoughts?
Priya: Prefer the second set for clarity on billing. But we should test microcopy: "Committed (discounted rate)" vs "Committed (volume pricing)".
Jenna: Draft microcopy for FAQ Q/A:
```
Q: How does committed capacity pricing work?
A: Choose a committed monthly GPU capacity to receive a lower per-token rate. You can adjust quarterly. Contact sales for enterprise contracts.
```
Is that too wordy?
Evan: Shorter please. Sales needs something they can paste into emails. Suggest: "Commit to a monthly capacity and get lower per-token pricing. Flexible adjustments quarterly."
Alex: Also add routing logic snippet I proposed for eng and ops: 
```
if lead.source == "pricing_calculator" and lead.estimate < 5000:
  route_to = "SDR"
elif lead.estimate >= 5000 or lead.company_size >= 200:
  route_to = "AE"
else:
  route_to = "SDR"
```
Marco: Nice. For calculator, let's surface "estimated monthly cost" and a CTA button: "Talk to sales" that triggers the routing tags.
Jenna: I made 3 webinar hooks based on benchmarks — cost-per-req comparisons, latency SLO stories, and migration checklist. Will share tonight.
Priya: Can we add an analytics event: `pricing_calc_variant` + `tier_selected` + `estimate_amount`? Need to attribute lift.
Alex: Yep I'll add tracking. Also will output a segmentation: trial vs enterprise visitor, referrer, and geo.
marketing-bot: Reminder — pricing-playbook v2 published. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing-playbook-v2. Reviewed by Legal?
Priya: Legal gave provisional sign-off on the FAQ language; they asked to avoid promising exact quarterly adjustments for committed tiers. Will update copy.
Evan: FYI — SDR script tweak: if calc_estimate > 2000 then ask about run-rate & ROI. I'll circulate a short doc.
Marco: Can we meet 11:00 tomorrow? I'll bring prototypes (A/B) and a short heatmap of flows.
Jenna: Works for me. I'll bring the webinar outline + CTAs.
Alex: 11:00 works. I'll bring conversion slices.
Priya: Cool — booked 11:00. Agenda: 15m calc prototypes, 10m tier naming + FAQ, 5m routing + tracking. Quick sync, no slide decks. :white_check_mark:
Evan: Great, I'll invite SDR lead and drop in routing rules.
marketing-bot: Event created: #marketing · Pricing experiments sync — 11:00 tomorrow. Attendees: Priya, Marco, Jenna, Evan, Alex.
Priya: Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.
